about_the_game:
"Dream Legend" is a uniquely styled survival shooting game where you'll fend off demon attacks in your sleep, bringing you an intense and thrilling level - breaking experience.

On the game's main interface, you can see a wealth of functional modules. Benefits like "Newbie Gift Pack" and "Weekly Card" help you get started quickly; "Daily Surprise" brings unexpected joys; and the "Task" system guides you to keep challenging yourself. Before entering a level, you can learn about the rewards corresponding to clearing the level with different amounts of health, so you can get ready for the battle.

After officially entering the game, you'll be in a challenging battlefield. The level progress and time are displayed at the top. You need to use your weapons to fend off enemy attacks and hold your ground. By constantly fighting, you can level up, unlock more powerful equipment and skills, and strive for higher goals in each level, experiencing the dual fun of survival and shooting.
